cases.title: Long run: 12 consecutive RANDOM_FAULTS trips (1860 simulated s, 30 s cycles) with AI on; nothing dropped, integrity ok
cases.input: 12 sessions x 155 s into one database
cases.expected: all samples accepted, none rejected, integrity ok, realtime factor > 5

cases.title: Memory does not grow without bound across 12 sessions (process working set)
cases.input: psapi working set after each trip
cases.expected: growth after the first trip < 150 MB
cases.actual: after trip 1: 291.6 MB; end: 296.9 MB; growth 5.3 MB

cases.title: A simulation longer than the 155 s driving profile keeps producing driving data and periodic fault effects
cases.expected: engine keeps running (RPM > 0) so cycles every 30 s remain meaningful
cases.actual: after 150 s: 2250 samples, max RPM=0.0 (engine stays off); 19 fault cycles are still scheduled up to 600 s
cases.notes: Duration is not exposed in the UI; reachable through the API/CLI. Faults scheduled after ~145 s have no effect on a parked vehicle.

cases.title: Repeated XAI explanations (200x) are fast and stable
Project-defined performance limits
cases.actual: The control file defines no numeric latency/throughput requirements (only non-blocking GUI, bounded queue 32, 120 ms UI refresh); results above are measurements, not pass/fail against a spec

cases.title: GUI stays responsive while 30x RANDOM_FAULTS + AI run, pages are switched and reports opened
cases.input: 25 s: switch pages every 150 ms, request reports
cases.expected: no event-loop gap > 1 s; no error shown; reports produced

cases.title: Starting a second session while one is running is refused with a message
cases.actual: {"second_start_message": "توجد جلسة قائمة؛ أوقفها قبل بدء مصدر آخر", "start_button_disabled_while_running": true, "source_locked": true}

cases.title: Export to an unwritable path shows a local error and does NOT stop the source or create a CONNECTION event (old defect A06)
cases.input: export during a running session to a missing folder and to a directory
cases.expected: error text, samples keep flowing, 0 CONNECTION events
cases.actual: {"export_to_missing_dir": "تعذر إكمال العملية: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'C:\\\\Users\\\\user\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\cl", "export_to_directory": "تعذر إكمال العملية: [Errno 13] Permission denied: 'C:\\\\Users\\\\user\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\claude\\\\C", "samples_still_flowing": true, "connection_events_created_by_export_errors": 0}

cases.title: A finite but physically absurd reading (RPM = 1e308) in a REPLAY file is not stored as AVAILABLE
cases.input: replay file with RPM=1e308 through Session into SQLite
cases.expected: flagged INVALID (or rejected) and a data-quality event
cases.notes: Root cause: DEMO_BOUNDS are applied only when source/provenance is SIMULATION or DEVICE_TEST (monitoring/data_quality.py); REPLAY and other sources have no bound at all.

cases.title: An unknown sensor id in a replay file is flagged (UNSUPPORTED + data-quality event), not silently accepted
cases.notes: The value is still persisted (flagged), unlike the TCP/serial receiver which rejects unadvertised sensors.
